scope: Proposed discovery-registry additions for the existing PR192 owner; not active providers or a published catalog.

candidates.name: ChordWiki Japanese chord and lyric catalog
candidates.reason: Publisher homepage currently reports 27,178 songs and ChordPro-based submissions; this is a publisher claim, not a corpus census. Terms clause3 limits its JASRAC-managed lyrics permission to on-site streaming and explicitly disallows download, copy and print; clause4 reserves remaining source/output rights to contributors. No song, editor-source or content request was made. Keep pending explicit compatible integration permission, recording/arrangement identity and source-credit preservation, and two independent permitted live canaries. Japanese coverage is a potential benefit; overlap and importer compatibility remain unmeasured.

candidates.name: GuitarParty lyrics chords and songbooks
candidates.reason: Publisher homepage describes lyrics/chords, transposition and custom songbooks. A current official third-party API contract and corpus size were not verified; historical third-party API clients are not permission evidence. Published terms sections6 and11 restrict copying/storage and automated extraction without express written consent; personal printing is narrower than Singbook saved-library integration. No song/API/authenticated-content request, account or credential was created. Defer pending a documented authorized API contract covering app retention, required attribution and rights, identity/schema verification and two independent live canaries.
